entries.0f84e7da655996c3: The company manufactures and sells asphalt products and others, performs intermediate treatment (recycling) of industrial waste, sells other construction materials, and runs a food and beverage business (operating conveyor-belt sushi restaurants), among others. Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥446 million, broken down into ¥164 million from manufacturing and sales, ¥218 million from food and beverage, and ¥64 million from other. The non-consolidated subsidiary Hashidate Namakonkurito Kogyo Co., Ltd. operates a ready-mixed concrete manufacturing and sales business, Sogo Giken Co., Ltd. operates a construction consulting business, and ＰＦＩ Maizuru Jodanchi Co., Ltd. performs maintenance of public housing.
entries.10944cf08029afc6: Of revenue of ¥8,837 million for the fiscal year ended December 2025, the Construction Business accounted for ¥8,391 million, the large majority, and manufacturing and sales businesses, etc., accounted for ¥446 million. The management policy states that, in the core Construction Business, the company will strengthen relationships with existing customers, develop new customers and win design-and-build projects, while promoting renewable energy initiatives and revitalizing local communities through the food service business; businesses other than construction are positioned as small-scale diversification.

entries.99fe96680a54263f: Since its founding in 1935, the company has built a record of civil engineering and construction works, based in northern Kyoto Prefecture. It has asphalt mixing plants in Miyazu City, Kyotamba Town and Yabu City, Hyogo Prefecture, and has a system to manufacture and sell, itself, the asphalt mixture used in paving works; it operates the Construction Business and manufacturing and sales businesses, etc., in an integrated manner. Its clients are mainly government agencies such as the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism and Kyoto Prefecture, and continuous receipt of public works orders forms the foundation of the business.
